claim.claim-text: 1. A method, comprising:

2. The method of claim 1, wherein the communications system is configured to perform at least one of Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (QAM), Amplitude Phase Shift Keying (APSK) modulation, or Orthogonal Frequency-Division Multiplexing.
3. The method of claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the communications system is a wireless communication system, a wired communication system, or a fiber optic communication system.

4. The method of any of the preceding claims, wherein identifying the set of constellation points includes mapping the received plurality of bits to the constellation diagram, optionally using a gray code.
5. The method of any of the preceding claims, further comprising causing transmission of at least one signal representing the plurality of complex numbers using the modulation scheme.
6. A method, comprising:
7. The method of claim 6, wherein the UBDM transformation includes a plurality of nonlinear layers and a plurality of linear layers.

8. The method of claim 6 or claim 7, wherein the predetermined modulation technique includes one of Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (QAM), Amplitude Phase Shift Keying (APSK) modulation, or Orthogonal Frequency-Division Multiplexing.
9. The method of any of claims 6 to 8, wherein the communications system is one of: a wireless communication system, a wired communication system, and a fiber optic communication system.
10. The method of any of claims 6 to 9, wherein the bit-to-symbol mapping is performed using a gray code.
11. The method of any of claims 6 to 10, wherein the subsequent processing includes at least one of pulse shaping or the application of at least one filter.
12. The method of any of claims 6 to 11, further comprising causing transmission of at least one signal representing the plurality of complex numbers using the modulation scheme.
13. A method for modulation-agnostic unitary braid division multiplexing (UBDM) signal transformation, the method including:
14. The method of claim 13, wherein the sending the resulting complex numbers is to a downstream portion of the communication system for at least one of pulse shaping or filter application.
15. The method of claim 13 or claim 14, wherein the method does not include the application of an inverse Fourier transform prior to sending the complex numbers.
16. The method of any of claims 13 to 15, wherein the method does not include generating of spreading codes.
17. The method of any of claims 13 to 16, wherein the bit-to-symbol map is a constellation diagram for a signal to be transmitted wirelessly, or through wired or fiber optic communication.
